notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; there is no hardware backend and no hardware run. The card's native is the registered environment-config class GraspKettleEnvFloatingDexHandRightCfg; the fake is this package's reduced pure Python Gymnasium environment and was not compared with Isaac Lab. The real environment needs Isaac Sim 5.1.0, Isaac Lab v2.3.2, a CUDA GPU and the gated USD assets (README.md:84-101 and :144-146); none were installed or run, and the sim backend (gymnasium.make of the registered id) was not run. The fake carries the 28-value action vector (3 wrist translation + 3 wrist rotation + 22 Shadow finger joints), bounds each value to [-1, 1] following the range scripts/zero_agent.py:312-313 samples (the clone does not state Isaac Lab's exact action-space bounds), advances one control step per tick at 60 Hz, truncates at 1200 control steps (20 s) and reproduces the action_l2/action_rate_l2 penalties. Its observation is reduced to policy 28, proprio 28, state 7 (object pose) and goal 3; the upstream contact, privileged, rgb, depth and pointcloud groups and the task success/termination terms are NOT COVERED and are listed in fidelity.gaps. No limit is operator_required, so there is no site-limits.example.json and no native.py. Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only affects the next reset), G7.MAYBE_ABSENT x5 for action_space, observation_space, reset, step and close because the card's native class is a config class whose Gymnasium environment base lies outside the clone, and G8.NO_UNIT x4 for bridge-derived integer inputs and the action array. Only catalogue classes cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest line the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
